name: MoT Cube Open 2026

venue.name: Mall of Travancore
venue.address: Int'l Airport Rd, near Ananthapuri Hospital, Eanchakkal, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695024

information:
**Important Reminders for Participants**

* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You WILL NOT be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late for the same.

* We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a comfortable ambience for all the fellow cubers. 

* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, make sure that you attend the first timers tutorial. 

* Please bring your ID card as well. 

* If this is not your first competition, you may be assignd with volunteering duties which you should perform without fail. The delegates and organizers can disqualify a competitior from participating in respective events upon not performing the assigned volunteering duties. 


**Happy cubing! :)**
